security_justification.trust_boundary: Two of the ten required merge contexts sit on the boundary that admits code to the protected mainline, and this change alters what one of them hands the other. The report handed over becomes exactly the set of components the analyser indexes, and a record that cannot be attributed fails the producing job instead of degrading into a warning.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No actor, tenant, or authority value is read, derived, or emitted. The change rewrites coverage record paths in a build artefact; nothing here participates in event authority.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization decision changes. The analyser token, host URL, project key and permission blocks are untouched, and the script reads no credential.
security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, catalog entry, or emitted record changes. The integrity that improves is the CI record's: the coverage artefact stops describing files the analysis excluded, so the two artefacts can no longer disagree silently.
security_justification.confidentiality: No data is read, stored, or transmitted that was not already. The script reads coverage reports and one properties file already in the workspace, writes the reports back, and prints paths already public in the repository.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: The script writes only the reports named in the gate's own report declaration, and every path this change edits is listed in the owned-path inventory. It writes no file outside the declared report set.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fail-closed, and deliberately more so than the state it replaces. A missing declared report, a record naming a path that does not exist, a report left with no records, and an exclusion pattern using an unimplemented glob construct each fail the required coverage job and name what failed. No existing failing arm is removed and no threshold is relaxed; the quality gate's three conditions are untouched.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Diagnostics name a report path, a record path, or an exclusion pattern — all repository-relative and already public. No file contents, environment values, or credential material are printed.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrency is introduced, removed, or reordered. The script processes the declared reports sequentially in one synchronous pass, and the job graph, its dependency edges and the analyser's own parallelism are unchanged.
security_justification.lifecycle: No lifecycle state, transition, or ordering changes. The script replaces an existing step in place, between the coverage runs that produce the reports and the artifact upload that publishes them, so nothing observes a report in a state it could not observe before.
security_justification.resource_retention: Nothing is retained. Each report is read, transformed and written once; no cache, queue, temporary file or store is added, and the artifact retention settings are untouched.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry or redelivery path changes. The coverage job's bounded artifact-upload retry and the sonar job's bounded scan and download retries are untouched, and the script itself performs no I/O that could be retried.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic material, algorithm, signature, or hash chain is introduced, read, or changed.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No field transformation, redaction, or privacy policy is involved. Coverage records contain file paths and execution counts, and no personal, user, or tenant data is in scope.
security_justification.external_security_integration: SonarQube is an existing required gate and remains one, on the same project key and quality profile. Nothing is integrated and no threshold moves; what changes is that the artefact handed to the existing integration matches the scope that integration declares.
